purpose: Teach: たちまち/因みに/御覧/益々/まわる/向う/ちび/ちょいと

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが入って来られるとたちまち空気が変わった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, as soon as Father would walk in the room, everything would shift.
lines.style: Quiet, floating recollection. Soft opening. Slow, deliberate pacing. Lets each memory land gently. Voice trails at the end like he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、因みに俳句もお詠みになってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm-hmm, and your father used to write haiku too, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm and knowing. Gentle question that isn't really asking—she's inviting him deeper in. Soft affection underneath. Conversational, no rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「御覧の通り」と仰って手本を示された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would say 'as you can see' and show me by example.
lines.style: Tender recollection with a small lift of wonder. Slow pacing. Voice firms slightly on 'as you can see'—he's quoting with reverence. Fades gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫が益々お気に入りだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandchildren became his favorites, didn't they, dear?
lines.style: Knowing murmur, gentle tease underneath. She's remembering something she observed, something she's treasuring. Soft, almost conspiratorial warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが地球儀をまわるのを見せて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would spin the globe for me and show me the world.
lines.style: Wondrous and still. Quiet opening on 'Gran.' Voice opens up slightly on 'globe'—a small boy's awe preserved in an old man's memory. Trails off with quiet tenderness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、向うのお山までよく散歩されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father used to take you walking all the way up to that far mountain, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Reflective, almost singing the memory. Gentle lilt on 'far mountain.' Her voice carries the shape of old journeys. Warm, intimate closing address to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「ちびっ子」と呼んで可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would call me 'little one' and loved me dearly.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'little one'—he's quoting the pet name with deep tenderness. Very slow, measured breathing. Almost fragile. Opens the memory like an old letter.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、「ちょいと」とよく仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father was always saying 'just a moment,' wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Quiet, intimate laugh underneath. Voice lowers conspiratorially. She's sharing something only they know—his habitual phrase, his presence. Close and warm.
